about: What GET /api/graph sends per page for section, bucket, kind and tags (lib/GraphModel.psm1). Invented data. tests/GraphModel.Tests.ps1 builds these pages in the in-memory OneNote (source vault: a page with obsn.id, obsn.type = kind and obsn.tags = tags in that section of a vault; source notebook: a plain page in that section of a connected notebook) and asserts the produced values equal this file (a vault page is matched by its id; a notebook page's real id is n:<OneNote id>, so it is matched by its section and the ids here are placeholders); the interface tests read the same file. section = the page's section path under the vault or notebook root; bucket = the fixed bucket of an ObsidiNote section (rollover and year folded in, every Archive section is Archive), or the section path itself for a section ObsidiNote does not own; kind = the page type, '' for a page that is not ObsidiNote's; tags = the page's hand-set tags, always a list ([] when none, also for one tag and for a page that is not ObsidiNote's). vaultTags / notebookTags = the model's own tags list for that source: every tag with its page count, sorted by name (ordinal), [] when no page has a tag.
